meta.dek: Topic 91 of the INSPIRE citation clustering (Particle physics), 6,230 papers, median year 1998. Shown: its 500 most cited papers, 67 of them with Latin American authors (the most cited of those come first, up to 20%); placed by year, every line is one paper citing another inside this set.
